note: Person-reviewed deny list for the Taxonomy free-photo ladder (DATA_DECISIONS §72). Round 14 widened the picture ladder beyond Wikidata P18 / Wikipedia lead images to the Wikimedia Commons category, GBIF occurrence media (observations only, free licences only), iNaturalist open data and PhyloPic silhouettes. Every new pick is reviewed on a Pillow contact sheet against its taxon name before shipping (.scratch/r14-contact-sheet.py); a picture that is not of the taxon -- or not a picture of an organism at all -- is listed here and the ladder falls through to its next CACHED candidate, and then to the next rung, without a refetch. Same shape of ruling as etl/reference/currency_image_rejects.json. `urls` is keyed on the file name or URL tail (percent-escapes decoded, underscores and case ignored); `taxa` is keyed on the Catalogue of Life id and refuses every ladder picture for that taxon, so it keeps the designed placeholder. Systematic faults are fixed in etl/sources/taxonomy.py instead of listed here one row at a time -- see the GBIF_LIVING_BASIS, _HOTLINK_HOSTILE and _SUPRAGENERIC_FILE rules, each of which came out of a contact sheet.

urls.H eccentricus lifecycle.jpg: Hemiuridae (family): a parasite LIFE-CYCLE DIAGRAM, not a picture of the animal. Contact sheet 2026-10-10, seed 14, tile 23.
urls.Nocardiopsis prasina.jpg: Streptosporangiales (order): a culture plate photographed through its handwritten lid label; the handwriting is the subject. A labelled silhouette is better. Contact sheet 2026-10-10, seed 14, tile 4.
urls.Synbranchiformes.jpg: Notacanthiformes (order): a picture of the SWAMP EELS, miscategorised into the spiny eels' Commons category. The wrong animal entirely. Contact sheet 2026-10-10, seed 27, tile 8. (The _SUPRAGENERIC_FILE rule now catches this class of mistake on its own; the row stays as the worked example.)
urls.Fmicb-15-1367658-g002.webp: Nitrososphaeria (class): a multi-panel journal figure whose bottom half is a line chart. Micrographs plus a graph is a figure, not a picture of the organism. Contact sheet 2026-10-10, seed 27, tile 28.
urls.proxyImageThumbnailLarge: Lecanicephalidea and anything else from images.ala.org.au's thumbnail proxy: it answers HTTP 403 to every client, browser user-agent included, so a GBIF media record pointing at it is a guaranteed broken picture. Contact sheet 2026-10-10, seed 27, tile 19. (Also blocked at source by _HOTLINK_HOSTILE.)
urls.photos/420593251/medium.jpeg: Cirlivirales (order): an iNaturalist photograph of bare tree branches, reached through a GBIF occurrence of a parrot circovirus. A virus is never what a citizen-science observation photographs. Contact sheet 2026-10-10, seed 41, tile 51. (The kingdom==Viruses rule in _gbif_media_candidates now skips the whole viral lineage; this row stays as the worked example.)
